title: Elemental Shield (General, level 100)
body:
Syntax: elemental shield [on|off] | perform elemental shield [on|off]

Unlocks at level 100 for all four classes. Practice once with a teacher. Inspired by the Raikage's lightning chakra armor, but shaped by YOUR OWN revealed chakra nature. Surround yourself in a moving chakra mantle that reduces all incoming damage by 30%, grants +5 accuracy on attacks, and increases your own element-matching offensive jutsu damage by 15%. Fire, Water, Wind, Earth, Lightning and other natural chakra natures can use it. If no chakra nature is selected, it still protects you but cannot boost elemental attacks.

Initial cost: 70 Chakra before level scaling. Maintenance: 6 Chakra every five seconds, in or out of combat. Cooldown: 20 seconds. The toggle follows you across rooms and persists through saves/relogs; it ends when switched OFF or its upkeep is unaffordable.

Does not stack defensive percentages with Sanctuary or any Barrier. Sanctuary's 50% protection wins over Elemental Shield's 30%, but the offensive bonus remains active. See HELP SANCTUARY.
